# Certified Against Which Oracle? Execution Labels Set the Reported Risk of Conformal Abstention for Text-to-SQL

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#oracle-abstention)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.25938v1) · arXiv:2609.25938v1, 22 September 2026

**Reading coverage:** All 34 pages: sections 1–9, references, Appendices A–H, every audit/robustness table, registration history and artifact disclosure; key risk, alignment and frontier plots visually inspected.

**Additional inspected sources:** [Official analysis artifacts](https://github.com/yahiko-l/text-to-sql-oracle-certificates)

## Research question

Execution-based calibration labels and the database used to cluster candidates can jointly determine an abstention system’s reported risk, without reliably measuring semantic correctness.

## Method

A two-by-two intervention crosses shipped-database versus multi-instance partitions with calibration labels, holding sampled candidates and answer selection fixed. The study audits rejected outputs with AI and separately obtains blinded expert labels for reference defects and both accepted/rejected outputs.

## Evaluation

Four SQL-specialist checkpoints, three seeds and 508 Spider-Realistic questions are evaluated with repeated question splits and schema-disjoint stress tests. Expert answer labels cover two checkpoints at one seed. The paper distinguishes preregistered panel outcomes from later score comparisons, relabeling and robustness analyses.

## What the results support

Suite labels raise measured risk by 2.73–10.23 points, but expert judgments show that neither oracle uniformly measures semantic risk. Most risk reduction comes from changing which questions receive answers. Oracle-aligned score advantages shrink or persist depending on the checkpoint under independent labels.

## Limits and qualifications

The certified loss is marginal wrong-answer probability, not error conditional on answering; database splits lack the exchangeability guarantee. The benchmark and endpoint were selected during exploration before fresh panel generation. AI census categories are not all human-validated, and expert coverage is limited. Archived code/results are available, but complete experiment reproduction was not performed.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

Directly motivates reporting calibration/evaluation oracles, answer rates, loss definitions and independent semantic audits alongside abstention guarantees, rather than equating stricter execution labels with truth.
